verses.text: Israel [was] a luxuriant vine; he set forth fruit for himself. With the increase of his fruit, he made an increase of the altars; according to the richness of his land, they made good pillars.

segments.text: Israel [was] a luxuriant vine; he set forth fruit for himself. With the increase of his fruit, he made an increase of the altars; according to the richness of his land, they made good pillars.

verses.text: Their heart has been divided, now they are guilty; He will break down their altars; He will demolish their pillars.

segments.text: Their heart has been divided, now they are guilty; He will break down their altars; He will demolish their pillars.

verses.text: For now they say, “There is no king for us, because we did not fear YHWH; and [as for] the king, what could he do for us?”

segments.text: For now they say, “There is no king for us, because we did not fear YHWH; and [as for] the king, what could he do for us?”

verses.text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely [in] cutting a covenant, and judgment sprouts up like a poison in the furrows of the field.

segments.text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely [in] cutting a covenant, and judgment sprouts up like a poison in the furrows of the field.

verses.text: For the calf of Beth-aven those dwelling in Samaria fear; indeed its people mourn over it, and its idolatrous priests who rejoiced over it, over its glory that has departed from it.

segments.text: For the calf of Beth-aven those dwelling in Samaria fear; indeed its people mourn over it, and its idolatrous priests who rejoiced over it, over its glory that has departed from it.

verses.text: Also it will be carried along to Assyria as tribute to the great king; Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his idol.

segments.text: Also it will be carried along to Assyria as tribute to the great king; Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his idol.

verses.text: Samaria will be cut off [with] her king, like a twig on the face of the water.

segments.text: Samaria will be cut off [with] her king, like a twig on the face of the water.

verses.text: The high places of Aven will be destroyed, and the sin of Israel; the thorn and thistle will come up over their altars, and they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” And to the hills, “Fall on us!”

segments.text: The high places of Aven will be destroyed, and the sin of Israel; the thorn and thistle will come up over their altars, and they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” And to the hills, “Fall on us!”

verses.text: From the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, O Israel. There they have stood. Did it not overtake them in Gibeah—the battle against the sons of iniquity?

segments.text: From the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, O Israel. There they have stood. Did it not overtake them in Gibeah—the battle against the sons of iniquity?

verses.text: When I desire, I will discipline them; and peoples will be gathered against them, at My disciplining them for the two of their transgressions.

segments.text: When I desire, I will discipline them; and peoples will be gathered against them, at My disciplining them for the two of their transgressions.

verses.text: And Ephraim [is] a trained heifer, loving to thresh; and I passed over upon her fair neck; I will drive Ephraim; Judah will plow; Jacob will harrow for him.

verses.text: Sow for yourselves unto righteousness, [and] reap to the mouth of loving devotion; break up for yourself the fallow ground, for [it is] time to seek YHWH, until He should come and shower righteousness upon you⁺.
